product.name: LiveForum
product.tagline: Consent-pinned live sessions, access grants, attributed chat, moderation receipts, and reviewed replay proposals.

module.description: Coordinate grants, consent, broadcasts, chat, prompts, responses, and replay proposals without silent access or moderation.

backend.databaseBoundary: All shared database access and tenant isolation remain behind the managed-oss-cloud API.

cleanRoom.statement: Original clean-room implementation of the live sessions software category, designed and written independently.
cleanRoom.sourceBoundary: Public category behavior informed requirements; implementation and product identity are original.

experience.releaseBoundary: Complete for every typed action declared by this product manifest; it does not claim feature parity with unrelated third-party products.
experience.headline: Consent-pinned live sessions

actions.title: Create governed live session
actions.description: Create a session with purpose, schedule, visibility, and an explicit recording mode.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry-safe key unique to this logical mutation.

actions.title: Issue approved presenter grant
actions.description: Issue a short-lived least-privileged presenter grant to one exact workspace admin after attributed access approval.

presenterRef.description: Exact workspace admin user ID receiving the grant.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry-safe key unique to this logical mutation.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the exact effect without changing domain state.

approval.description: Attributed human approval of the exact requested effect.

actions.title: Issue approved attendee access
actions.description: Issue a short-lived attendee access record to one exact authenticated workspace identity after an explicit access decision.

attendeeRef.description: Exact authenticated workspace user ID receiving access.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry-safe key unique to this logical mutation.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the exact effect without changing domain state.

approval.description: Attributed human approval of the exact requested effect.

actions.title: Record participant media consent
actions.description: Record only the authenticated participant's exact granted, declined, or revoked scopes from an immutable subject interaction receipt.

participantRef.description: Exact authenticated workspace user ID giving this decision.

idempotencyKey.description: A retry-safe key unique to this logical mutation.

actions.title: Start approved broadcast
